subject.title: fix(ui): add timeout to control-ui bootstrap config fetch

question: Should the Control UI treat 15 seconds as the maximum wait for bootstrap configuration and silently continue with defaults, including on slow reverse-proxy deployments?
rationale: The patch is mechanically sound, but the cutoff changes existing behavior from eventual server-config application to fallback defaults, and the repository has no documented latency contract for this authenticated endpoint.

options.title: Accept the 15-second fallback
options.body: Approve the current threshold and caller-signal precedence, then rebase and require fresh checks before merge.

options.title: Adjust timeout semantics
options.body: Choose a different threshold or compose caller cancellation with a deadline, then update focused tests and live proof.

options.title: Keep eventual config loading
options.body: Decline the deadline if losing late server-provided metadata is less acceptable than leaving the background request pending.

recommendation.title: Accept the 15-second fallback
recommendation.body: Approve the current threshold and caller-signal precedence, then rebase and require fresh checks before merge.
